regime_context: The Hong Kong detector shows a narrow leadership contest: Tech Hardware & Semis is the headline eligible trend (durable at 0.61, not crowded, but only 16.7% breadth), while Diversified Miners lead in momentum rank but are ineligible. Only 5 of 17 themes are eligible, indicating selective opportunity. The absolute-trend gate—the only validated edge in this market—materially reduces drawdown risk when filtering to eligible themes. Macro backdrop remains AI/tech-focused with very high unscheduled news share, adding noise.
emerging_watch: Watch if Tech Hardware & Semis overtakes Diversified Miners in rank by a margin >1.0 and its breadth expands above 0.3—that would confirm a leadership handoff. Until then, no directional rotation call.

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet

The validated edge shows that avoiding non-eligible themes historically reduces drawdowns in this market; the rank-IC of momentum is near zero, so low rank alone is not a fade signal, but the eligibility filter is the actionable risk-control leg.
theses.dissent: China tech could rebound sharply on surprise policy or AI catalysts, and the absolute-trend gate is a risk-control device, not a return predictor—avoiding it may mean missing a sharp rally.
